actions.answer: Re-run the estimate at your realistic 2027 income first, because the credit is the benchmark silver premium minus an income-based contribution: below 400% of FPL you still get a credit, though smaller than under the expired enhanced credits (KFF), and above 400% there is no credit by law; a cheaper or bronze plan lowers what you pay but trades premium for deductible (KFF: average deductible rose 37% in 2026 vs 2025 as enrollees moved to bronze) and lower-income enrollees can lose cost-sharing reductions by leaving silver; HealthCare.gov says enroll by December 15 for January 1 coverage with a January 15 final deadline on that platform, and state exchanges may differ.

outline.purpose: Opening answer with the conditions that change it

outline.heading: What Gemini Can See Through Google Wallet and Plaid
outline.purpose: Transaction data from linked accounts, rewards and passes; example prompts Google lists

outline.heading: What Gemini Cannot Do With Your Money
outline.purpose: Google says Gemini can only read the data and cannot move, manage, invest, update or delete linked accounts; stated as Google's description of the connected app, not as a guarantee of safety

outline.heading: What Google and Plaid Store While Your Accounts Are Linked
outline.purpose: Google Pay Help: both store account or card number, routing number, transaction history, balance, name, address, phone and email while linked; Gemini Connected Apps help lists Wallet data as payment methods, receipts, Wallet data and linked financial account info; Keep Activity must be on, so Gemini Apps Activity is part of the trade-off

outline.heading: Who Can Use It Today
outline.purpose: US, 18+, personal Google Account, English, mobile app and web, Keep Activity on, not in Gems or Gemini Live; note blog vs Help page wording on rollout

outline.heading: How to Turn Off Google Wallet in Gemini and Delete Your Data
outline.purpose: Two steps per Gemini help: delete chats containing the info from Gemini Apps Activity AND disconnect the app (disconnecting alone can leave info in past chats); turning off Personal Intelligence does not stop chats being saved; unlink accounts in Google Wallet settings (Google then deletes that account's transaction history); Plaid Portal can delete data from Plaid systems; Plaid keeps data for non-Google links until removed there

outline.heading: Privacy Trade-Offs for Budgeting
outline.purpose: What sharing buys (spending review, subscription and price-increase flags, holiday budget) vs. what it costs; alternatives such as a manual budget; plainly lists what Google's and Plaid's pages do not answer: how long Gemini keeps chat content that contains account details, and how Plaid treats data after you unlink inside Google Wallet (we did not read Google's separate Gemini data-handling page)

outline.heading: Common Questions About Gemini and Google Wallet
outline.purpose: FAQ on safety, cost, disconnecting, work accounts

newPageBriefs.takeaway: Connect it only if you want conversational spending analysis and accept that Google and Plaid store your account details and transaction history while linked and that your chats with Gemini are saved while Keep Activity is on (Google describes Gemini's access as read-only, which limits actions, not data exposure); it applies to adults with a personal US account; skip or use a manual budget if you do not want financial data linked to an AI product.
